Heat shock protein 90 (HSP90) inhibitors (HSP90i), traditionally investigated for cancer treatment, have shown potential as senolytic agents. However, inhibitors face formulation, toxicity, and cost challenges. To overcome these limitations, we employed a virtual screening approach combining structure‐based prefiltering with a ligand‐based pharmacophore model to identify novel, potentially safe HSP90 alpha isoform inhibitors exhibiting senolytic properties.
